game.title: Deus Ex: Mankind Divided
game.build_notes: Verified 2026-09-17 on RTX (home PC, 3440x1440 desktop): version 1.19 build 801.0. Steam launch -> the launcher inside the exe -> Play -> main menu, windowed 1280x720 via the registry, quit with WM_CLOSE + Yes.

input.api: mouse clicks for the launcher and the quit dialog; keyboard menu driving not established

states.name: launcher
states.detect: A launcher window inside the exe, 790x445, window class NxApp: 'Play Deus Ex: Mankind Divided', Options, Website..., Quit.

states.name: main_menu
states.detect: STORY / BREACH / JENSEN'S STORIES / EXTRAS / OPTIONS / SHOP / SQUARE ENIX / QUIT.

states.name: quit_confirm
states.detect: In-game 'Quit game?' with Yes / No, raised by WM_CLOSE.

steps: wait for the launcher window (class NxApp)
click Play at about (345*1.79, 40*1.79) px from the launcher's top-left (1.79 = the display scale on RTX)
PostMessage WM_CLOSE to the game window
VERIFY the process has exited before the next step
routes.notes: A WM_CLOSE alone leaves the game running (see hazards).

entry_points.launcher_skip_switch: -nolauncher is in the exe's strings [inferred-static 2026-09-17]; not tried.
config_files: Registry HKCU\Software\Eidos Montreal\Deus Ex: MD\Graphics (DWORDs): Fullscreen=0, WindowWidth=1280, UserWindowWidth=1280, WindowHeight=720, UserWindowHeight=720 gave a 1296x759 window [verified-live 2026-09-17, n=1]. A .reg backup was exported first.
entry_points.logs: Documents\Deus Ex -  Mankind Divided\Deus Ex -  Mankind Divided.log (note the double space)
entry_points.proxy_dll: dxgi.dll beside DXMD.exe: hit the AcGenral early call, then CreateDXGIFactory2, CompatValue, CreateDXGIFactory [verified-live 2026-09-17, n=1].

hazards.hazard: WM_CLOSE asks 'Quit game?' instead of exiting
hazards.notes: A WM_CLOSE sent while the next step assumed the game was gone left it running. Click Yes, then verify the process has exited.

hazards.hazard: The dxgi proxy is called before its DllMain runs
hazards.notes: Windows' AcGenral compatibility shim calls dxgi SetAppCompatStringPointer before the proxy's DllMain has loaded the real dxgi.dll (found in x64dbg). A proxy must resolve the real function on that early call instead of jumping through an empty table.
The launcher's layout is scaled 1.79x on RTX; scale click offsets by the window's display scale on other machines.
